_comment: Portable hook wiring for ai-harness-lite. Machine scopes must use names from config.toml; optional tools are checked by each hook before use.
_note: Managed hook entries are preserved from the source manifest. Dormant scripts remain unwired until explicitly enabled.

hooks._why: Portable advisory lifecycle detection: mark only positively provenanced scratch linked worktrees for one-shot checklist injection; grant no landing or reclamation authority.
hooks.name: worktree-lifecycle-session-start

hooks._why: Portable advisory lifecycle injection: consume the scratch-session flag once and present the seven-check handoff without granting mutation authority. ISSUE-REF raised the budget 5 -> 30 s and this copy was left behind: the hook's entire cost is process creation, which is global contention it cannot control, and under 8 concurrent invocations it measured a 6.5 s median with 5 of 8 runs over 5 s -- so every overrun printed 'timed out after 5s -- output discarded' and the injection silently did not happen. 30 is a CAP, not a delay.
hooks.name: worktree-lifecycle-prompt-inject

hooks._why: Portable context-pressure escalation: the existing PreToolUse notice path is advisory at 55–79% and returns a native FORCE deny at 80%+ until Skill(save-state) opens the persisted grace window through CC-START.
hooks.name: context-high-escalation

hooks._why: Blocks with exit 2 when a Write/Edit leaves a markdown file citing a gitignored or untracked path as its evidence (ISSUE-REF). A citation to an ignored path reads as authoritative and resolves to nothing from any clone, and reaping the worktree that holds it destroys the only copy. It fires only on *.md inside a git work tree; a file outside any work tree exits 0 silently, while the checker's own no-verdict exit BLOCKS. Timeout matches the source manifest's 15s, which tests/test_hooks_manifest_share_parity.py requires.
hooks.name: evidence-citation-gate
